samples.summary: The new `posMax` overrun guard has no test — deleting it would keep the whole suite green
samples.evidence: `imgRule` matches `IMG_TAG_RE` against the *whole* `state.src` (sticky, aimed at `state.pos`) and therefore has to re-enforce the inline region bound itself at img-plugin.ts:171 (`if (state.pos + match[0].length > state.posMax) return false;`) — a branch the comment above it justifies at length. No test in img-plugin.test.ts constructs an input where the tag runs past `posMax`: the only nested-region case is `'[](https://example.com)'` (img-plugin.test.ts:80), where the tag fits entirely inside the link label. A case like `[before `, where the `>` sits beyond the label's `posMax`, is absent, so the guard is untested and its removal (or an off-by-one in it) would not fail anything. Failure mode is a mangled inline render / `state.pos` advanced past the region.

samples.summary: `parseAttrs`'s malformed-region rejection (gap text / trailing junk must be whitespace) is never exercised
samples.evidence: Two guards decide whether the attribute region is a plain attribute list: img-plugin.ts:107 (`region.slice(cursor, match.index).trim() !== ''`) and img-plugin.ts:131 (trailing remainder). Walking every refusal fixture in img-plugin.test.ts:96-114, each is rejected by a *different* branch: unknown-name (`onerror`, `style`, `srcset`, `class`), DIMENSION_RE (`200px`, `calc(...)`, `-5`, `12.5`, `''`), duplicate name, missing/empty/valueless `src`, `validateLink`. None contains stray non-attribute text such as ``, `` or ``, so neither whitespace-gap check has coverage. If either regressed, junk regions would be accepted and silently rendered as an img.
searchedFor: read img-plugin.test.ts refusal table line by line
traced each fixture to the branch that rejects it in parseAttrs

samples.summary: Unquoted-attribute-value behavior asserted only in a comment, not in a test (incl. the self-close strip eating an unquoted trailing `/`)
samples.evidence: The ATTR_RE comment (img-plugin.ts:79-82) claims `src=a b` reads as two attributes rather than one value with a space, and SELF_CLOSE_RE (img-plugin.ts:76) strips a trailing `/` from the region, which for an unquoted value means `` yields `src=dir`. The suite covers unquoted values only in the happy case (`width=50%`, img-plugin.test.ts:31) and the self-close only with quoted values (`''`, line 137). No test pins `` being refused or `` losing its slash, so a silently mangled `src` (broken image for the user) could ship.
searchedFor: searched the test file for unquoted src fixtures and for '/' handling

samples.summary: Wall-clock assertion (`elapsed < 1_000`) is machine-dependent coverage for the backtracking regression
samples.evidence: img-plugin.test.ts:140-156 measures `performance.now()` around a single `render()` and asserts under 1s. The 11s→ms margin makes it usually reliable, but on a loaded CI runner this is the kind of assertion that flakes, and it is the *only* coverage for the ReDoS shape. A structural check (e.g. asserting the tag regex has no adjacent whitespace quantifiers, or scaling: 2x input ⇒ well under 4x time) would be deterministic.

samples.summary: Alt-text escaping tested only for pre-escaped entities; a raw `"` or a backslash escape in the value is untested
samples.evidence: The escaping test (line 61-69) feeds `alt="<b> & more"`, i.e. input that is already entity-escaped. `parseAttrs` runs values through `md.utils.unescapeAll` (img-plugin.ts:128), so a value like `alt='say "hi"'` or `alt="a\\_b"` takes a different path into the attribute slot; neither is asserted. Also untested: `height="50%"` (percent is only covered for `width`) and a tag whose attribute region spans a newline under `breaks: true`.
searchedFor: grep for 'unescapeAll' and 'height' in the test file
